answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in jetty, checked in whisper, and ivory shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 704 identities would post 2821 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
